properties.statement:
AN OWED ITEM THAT DISSOLVED ON INSPECTION, 2026-08-22. Two sessions carried "REDO TWO `review_relations` CALLS" as debt. Reading the code closed it in five minutes and it should never have been carried.

THE ITEM: `dec:idea-a-capability-checked-only-at-unit-level-is-a-finding` and `dec:idea-do-another-projects-principles-belong-in-reflow2-or-only-the-machinery` had their `no_relation_note` written by hand with `create_node`, because `review_relations` was absent from that session's tool surface. The redo was owed so the writes would go through the proper door.

WHAT THE CODE ACTUALLY DOES:
  · `review_relations` with a note and no links writes EXACTLY ONE THING — `no_relation_note` on the node (`relate.rs`). No timestamp, no reviewed marker, no edge.
  · `unreviewed_ideas` clears a Decision on `properties.contains_key("no_relation_note")`. It reads the PROPERTY and cannot see how the property got there.

⇒ The hand-written notes are already recognised, already carry substantive content (each says what was searched and why nothing was honestly related), and the redo would write the same key with the same value. VERIFIED: both nodes carry the property in the committed export, and neither appears in the unconnected-idea finding.

⭐ THE ONLY THING THE TOOL ADDS IS ITS WRITE-TIME REFUSAL — it rejects a review that records neither links nor a note, so "nobody looked" can never masquerade as "somebody looked and found nothing". That guard protects against an EMPTY review, and both of these are full ones. It would have passed.

🛑 THE LESSON IS NOT ABOUT `review_relations`. It is that an owed item was carried across two sessions and one handoff note on the strength of a REASONABLE ASSUMPTION — that going through the tool must do something the direct write did not — which nobody spent five minutes checking. The same day, and in the same session, the gh `remote-https` root cause was re-derived from scratch while a three-day-old node already held it. TWO INSTANCES, ONE SHAPE: work carried or repeated because nobody read what was already there. Debt should be re-read before it is re-scheduled.

WHAT REMAINS TRUE: the tool surface defect is real and separate. `review_relations`, `move_component` and `set_capability_delivery` were missing from two consecutive sessions (151 of 155 served tools), and the standing hypothesis is that the client fixes its tool list AT CONNECT and the shared server was stale at that moment. That is worth confirming; this note only says the REDO is not.
